request.name: encode_reference_only
request.description: Prepare reference VQ codes without generating speech. Use the task API to receive drama3_reference_v1 acoustic-token artifacts.

request.name: multi_reference_cond
request.description: Ordered references as JSON: [{text, audio_path or vq_codes}]. Speaker tags 0..15 select voices.

request.name: previous_takes
request.description: Continuation/edit history as a JSON array of {text, vq_codes or audio_path}; a string generates that earlier take first.

request.name: previous_takes_file
request.description: JSON history file containing a take object or an ordered array of earlier takes. Avoids the Windows command-line length limit for VQ grids.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated acoustic frames per text chunk (about 21.5 frames/second).

request.name: temperature
request.description: Main and residual sampling temperature. Zero makes the initial draws greedy; semantic repeat redraws retain the fixed Drama 3 RAS settings.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Inclusive nucleus cutoff before top-k filtering, matching Drama 3.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k candidate count. The default 4097 keeps every candidate (no cap), as Fish's Drama 3 Space does; 30 can stall in long silences.

session.name: backbone_prefill_cache_mb
session.description: Bounded cache of backbone prefill graphs, in MiB. Reuses exact shapes and their CUDA captures. One active graph is retained even if larger than this budget. Zero retains only the active graph.

session.name: tower_prefill_cache_mb
session.description: Bounded cache of audio-tower prefill graphs, in MiB. Reuses exact shapes and their CUDA captures. Zero disables it.

session.name: device_sampling
session.description: Enable tower decode and codebook sampling in one cached backend graph. Uses F32 probabilities; sampled outputs may differ from the host sampler.

session.name: profile_first_audio
session.description: Emit first-audio stage timings to stderr for performance diagnosis. Disabled by default.

session.name: context_length
session.description: Cache capacity for prompt plus generated frames; includes references and history.

session.name: cpu_expert_layers
session.description: Number of the 40 expert banks kept and evaluated on CPU; use 4 for a 24 GB profile or 24 for a 16 GB profile. Dense layers and the tower use the selected backend.

session.name: disk_experts
session.description: Read routed expert weights from GGUF on demand into a bounded cache instead of keeping full expert banks resident. Trades speed for memory; default false.

session.name: pin_experts
session.description: Keep full expert banks in pinned host RAM for direct cache-miss uploads. Requires disk_experts and pinned host-buffer support; default false.

session.name: expert_cache_size
session.description: Resident expert slots per layer in disk_experts mode; 8 to 256. Larger caches trade memory for fewer disk reads; ignored in resident mode.

session.name: disk_expert_read_threads
session.description: Host workers for copying selected GGUF experts into staging when disk_experts is enabled and pin_experts is false. Default 1 preserves serial reads; values above 1 use OpenMP or Apple dispatch.

session.name: codec_encoder_f32_accumulation
session.description: Use F32 accumulation for F16 reference-encoder GEMMs on Vulkan. Try this if voice cloning produces incomplete speech or reaches the token limit. Other backends and codec decoding are unchanged.

session.name: codec_encoder_bf16_compute
session.description: Use BF16 reference-encoder arithmetic on CUDA with F16/BF16 codec weights; default true. Decoding is unchanged.

session.name: codec_encoder_chunk_samples
session.description: Reference-encoder convolution chunk size in samples at the codec sample rate. Use 0 for full encoding or a positive multiple of 512; default 0.

session.name: codec_backend
session.description: Run the codec on the selected backend or on CPU.

description.en: Fish Audio Drama 3 native MoE speech generation, voice cloning, and continuation.
description.zh: Fish Audio Drama 3 原生 MoE 语音生成、音色克隆与续写。

encode_reference_only.en: Prepare reference VQ codes without generating speech. Use the task API to receive drama3_reference_v1 acoustic-token artifacts.
encode_reference_only.zh: 仅准备参考 VQ 编码，不生成语音。通过 task API 获取 drama3_reference_v1 声学 token 产物。

reference_text.zh: 行内参考音频对应的文本。

multi_reference_cond.en: Ordered references as JSON: [{text, audio_path or vq_codes}]. Speaker tags 0..15 select voices.
multi_reference_cond.zh: 按顺序排列的参考 JSON：[{text, audio_path 或 vq_codes}]。说话人标签 0..15 用于选择音色。

previous_takes.en: Continuation/edit history as a JSON array of {text, vq_codes or audio_path}; a string generates that earlier take first.
previous_takes.zh: 续写/编辑历史，JSON 数组 {text, vq_codes 或 audio_path}；字符串会先生成该历史 take。

previous_takes_file.en: JSON history file containing a take object or an ordered array of earlier takes. Avoids the Windows command-line length limit for VQ grids.
previous_takes_file.zh: 包含 take 对象或有序历史数组的 JSON 文件；用于避免 Windows 命令行长度限制。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated acoustic frames per text chunk (about 21.5 frames/second).
max_tokens.zh: 每个文本分块生成的最大声学帧数（约 21.5 帧/秒）。

text_chunk_size.zh: 长文本分块的最大字符数。

temperature.en: Main and residual sampling temperature. Zero makes the initial draws greedy; semantic repeat redraws retain the fixed Drama 3 RAS settings.
temperature.zh: 主采样与残差采样温度。0 使初始采样为贪心；语义重复重采样仍使用固定的 Drama 3 RAS 设置。

top_p.en: Inclusive nucleus cutoff before top-k filtering, matching Drama 3.
top_p.zh: top-k 过滤前的包含式核采样阈值，与 Drama 3 一致。

top_k.en: Top-k candidate count. The default 4097 keeps every candidate (no cap), as Fish's Drama 3 Space does; 30 can stall in long silences.
top_k.zh: top-k 候选数量。默认 4097 保留全部候选（不设上限），与 Fish Drama 3 Space 一致；30 可能在长静音处卡住。

seed.zh: 可复现的原生采样随机种子。
